newsitem.title: USA: Shiva to use higher speed modem technology.
newsitem.headline: Shiva to use higher speed modem technology.

text.p: Shiva Corp said Friday it plans to use breakthrough 56 kilobit per second modem technology developed by Rockwell International Corp in Shiva's remote network product lines.
The faster 56 kilobit technology doubles the current 28.8 kilobit rate for modem communication transmissions over conventional copper telephone lines.
Shiva said it will use the new technology in products for small offices/home offices (SOHOs), central corporate sites, telecoms carriers, and Internet Service Providers (ISPs).

Shiva noted that the new 56 kilobit per second modem technology is a lower cost alternative to Integrated Services Digital Network communications, which, while offering transmission speeds up to four times the rate of conventional 28.8 kilobit modems is not compatible with standard phone lines.
It said that users not prepared to make the investment in ISDN technology, equipment and expertise at remote locations such as home offices will now have an alternative technology.
The Shiva statement did not say when products would be available using the 56 kilobit technology.
